mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS "menuId" , m.menu_nm AS "menuName" , fd.fil_seq AS "icoFilSeq" , p.pgm_cd AS "programCode" , p.pgm_url AS "programUrl" FROM ysc.menu_mng m JOIN ysc.pgm_mng p ON p.pgm_cd = m.pgm_cd LEFT JOIN ysc.fil_bas fb ON fb.fil_seq = m.ico_fil_seq LEFT JOIN ysc.fil_dtl fd ON fd.fil_seq = fb.fil_seq AND fd.fil_dtl_seq = 1 WHERE m.menu_lvl = 1 AND m.menu_typ = #{menuType} AND m.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.sort_ord, m.menu_id

SELECT m.menu_id AS "menuId" , m.menu_nm AS "menuName" , m.up_menu_id AS "upperMenuId" , m.menu_lvl AS "menuLevel" , m.sort_ord AS "sortOrder" , m.menu_typ AS "menuType" , fd.fil_seq AS "icoFilSeq" , p.pgm_cd AS "programCode" , p.pgm_url AS "programUrl" FROM ysc.menu_mng m LEFT JOIN ysc.pgm_mng p ON p.pgm_cd = m.pgm_cd AND p.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN ysc.fil_bas fb ON fb.fil_seq = m.ico_fil_seq LEFT JOIN ysc.fil_dtl fd ON fd.fil_seq = fb.fil_seq AND fd.fil_dtl_seq = 1 WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.sort_ord, m.menu_lvl, m.menu_id

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ysc.menu_mng m JOIN ysc.fil_bas fb ON fb.fil_seq = m.ico_fil_seq JOIN ysc.fil_dtl fd ON fd.fil_seq = fb.fil_seq AND fd.fil_dtl_seq = 1 WHERE m.ico_fil_seq = #{_parameter} AND m.use_yn = 'Y' )
